content_sections.heading: About ICMR
content_sections.text: The Indian Council of Medical Research is an autonomous organisation under the Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. According to the notice, it deals with biomedical and health research in various areas, in collaboration with national and international agencies. It works through its headquarters at New Delhi, 29 Institutes/Centres and a large number of field stations across the country.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. Eligibility must be met on the last date of submission of the application. DQ: Ph.D. from a recognised University in Biophysics/Molecular Biology/Biochemistry. DE: Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to the job requirements, in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions. The notice gives research on structural biology using Cryo-Electron microscope [Cryo-EM] for biological specimens, in particular macromolecular complexes, with the use of Cryo-EM reconstruction algorithms and computational skills, as the job requirement. PhD is considered as 4 years' experience, irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree. MD/MS or equivalent is considered as 3 years' experience. MVSc is considered as 2 years' experience. MPH/M.Tech/ME is not considered as any experience. Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences, relevant to the job requirements, in Govt./Public sector/Private Institutions is admissible. The period spent on obtaining the minimum essential educational qualification does not count towards experience. Qualifications and experience may be relaxed for exceptionally meritorious candidates, with the approval of the DG, ICMR, for reasons to be recorded in writing. The upper age limit is 45 years, relaxable in accordance with GOI instructions. The notice does not list the relaxations category by category. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Masters from a recognised university in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences OR Pharm-D degree recognized by UGC/PCI

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is in Level 12 of the Pay Matrix (Rs.78,800-2,09,200), 7th CPC Scale, with usual allowances as admissible to ICMR employees. The appointment is on regular basis under Direct Recruitment. The initial posting is at ICMR-NIRBI, Kolkata, with all India transfer liability under the Council.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR Scientist-D (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Visit https://recruitment.icmr.org.in and register. The details filled in the registration form cannot be changed once registered. Acknowledgement of successful registration is sent to the registered email ID/mobile number. Click "Applicant login" and use the User ID and password received on email and mobile number. Click "Go to Application Form" and fill the sections one by one, using "Save and Next". The next section opens only when mandatory details are filled and required documents are uploaded. Upload the documents, photograph and signature as per the instructions. Click "Submit". You are then redirected to make the payment, and the application is considered complete once payment is done. Fee is accepted only through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card. After successful submission, the final printout of the application can be taken again. No offline application form or copy of the downloaded form is accepted. A hard copy of the final printout with all uploaded documents may be submitted when ICMR calls upon the candidate to do so. The fee is paid through the online link given in the application form. Scanned self-attested/attested copies of certificates in support of educational qualifications (from Matric onwards). Certificates of detailed marks obtained in these courses. Date of birth proof. Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD). Experience certificates. Photograph, which should be unattested, without cap or goggles (spectacles are allowed), and signature. Candidates who fail to upload self-attested copies of the required documents have their candidature cancelled and are not allowed to take part in later stages. The notice also advises keeping a few identical photographs in reserve for use at the time of test or document verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is made on the basis of a computer-based test (MCQs) or interview or both. The computer-based test, if conducted, is based on the understanding of research methods and is of qualifying nature. The notice does not give a test or interview date, venue or marks. First, all candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility in age, educational qualifications and experience (wherever required) are shortlisted. If too many are shortlisted to call all for interview, ICMR further shortlists on criteria fixed by the Competent Authority, ICMR. ICMR generally prefers to call candidates with higher experience in the relevant fields or higher educational qualification, as decided by the Appointing Authority. This may vary from case to case. At the time of personal discussion, applicants working in Centre/State Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings and Govt. funded research agencies must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer, with an undertaking that the applicant will be relieved within one month of receipt of the appointment order.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the closing date, for whatever reason, are liable to be rejected, as are incomplete applications or those without supporting documents. Duplicate applications result in cancellation of all such applications, without intimation. No request to change particulars in the online form is entertained after submission. Likely causes of rejection include: more than one application for a category, incomplete or non-online application, fee not fully deposited, lacking the academic qualification on the cut-off date, age outside the limit on the cut-off/closing date, and missing documents (including the MCI registration certificate and category certificate). Documents are checked only at scrutiny. False or suppressed information can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, even after appointment, and criminal prosecution. Outside influence, political or otherwise, disqualifies the candidate. Further details are displayed on the ICMR website only. ICMR may modify, cancel or publish afresh the vacancy circular, and disputes fall under the jurisdiction of Courts in New Delhi. For technical or payment queries, call on working days between 9:30 AM and 5:30 PM (IST) on O11-26589167 (as printed in the notice) or email [email protected] .
